cohort: The study included 299 women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) and 299 matched healthy pregnant women.
finding: Distinct cfDNA fragment characteristics associated with GDM are identified throughout pregnancy, allowing for early prediction and characterization of GDM and offering insights into its molecular underpinnings.
